tools.name: route_prompt
tools.description: Shows which task class and model tier JEV's jev-auto router would pick for a coding prompt. Use to explain or predict routing decisions.

tools.name: get_client_setup
tools.description: Returns the exact configuration that points Claude Code, Codex or Cursor at a JEV gateway. Use when a user asks how to connect a coding agent to JEV.

tools.name: get_mcp_install_commands
tools.description: Returns the commands that install a remote MCP server into Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, plus a one-click Cursor install link. Use when a user wants to add an MCP server URL to their agents.

tools.name: list_model_aliases
tools.description: Lists the JEV model names (jev-auto, jev-fast, …) and what each one does. Use when choosing which model name to configure.
